assay_wing.name: Assay Wing
assay_wing.description: A synthesis shell, 3.46 m of it: five open cells cut into one wing, each holding the SAME specimen under a different regime of testing. none is the specimen and nothing else. gauge stands a graduated column beside it with a fixed 0-to-0.80 scale, an arm riding on the specimen's actual crown and a pointer at the measured departure. control draws the untreated copy at the specimen's own rest extent with one vector per mass from where it was to where it is. chart plots the departure series on that same fixed scale, ending at the number the pointer stands at. vitrine puts glass on four posts around it, capped and captioned, and is the one cell whose every dimension is a constant. All 75 masses, the series, the reading and the crown come from ONE evaluation performed at build time. Nothing moves, nothing is random, and the artifact has no per-frame code at all.
interactions: walk the row from the bare cell to the glass one
read the gauge's pointer, then look at the control cell and decide whether the number was worth anything
compare the same specimen under five regimes and notice that only one of them keeps a shape
assay_wing.capacity: SEE that the five values of `assay` are not a staircase from phenomenon to museum piece — a gauge adds an instrument and loses the shape, a chart adds the history of the thing the gauge already lost, and the plainest apparatus on the row is the only one that keeps what happened
assay_wing.qfep_connection: F is the treatment: one closed-form displacement field, evaluated once, identical in every cell, which is why the row is a comparison and not five drawings. E is the four accounts, and they are irreducible to each other — a mean cannot be recovered from a vector field and neither can be recovered from a case of glass, which is why the family needed a word for the choice at all. lambda is how much apparatus the laboratory is willing to build before it decides something counts. The dark spot is the fifth cell: a vitrine is the only regime here that could be built without ever looking at the specimen, and it is the one that says most loudly that a result has been reached.
assay_wing.relationships:
Synthesised out of the nineteen artifacts that declare an `assay` axis — the corpus's most disciplined large family, and the only large one with exactly ONE vocabulary: none | gauge | control | chart | vitrine, character for character in all nineteen, no reordering. Every one was read, and the wing takes something specific from each group.

[[mass_spring_bench]] OWNS the kit in this file's sense: its ASSAYS list, its ASSAY_TOP of 0.86 and its ASSAY_READ / ASSAY_WIRE accents are read here by preload, the link [[slot_machine]] makes to prng_crank_machine and nine artifacts make in total, so the vocabulary and the palette cannot drift. Its bench height is this wing's cell floor. Its truth statement — 'NOBODY MODELLED THIS SHAPE, THE SPRINGS DID' — is the wing's `gravity`, and its picture (spheres at the masses, a lattice you can count) is how every specimen here is drawn.

[[petri_dish_worms]] wrote the family's sharpest sentence about the third rung: `control` is 'a second, identical, EMPTY dish standing 0.40 m away' whose content is an ABSENCE, and it 'turns a thing you are watching into an experiment you could disagree with'. That sentence is the whole reason the third cell here is the one that wins. It is also one of only two members whose record board carries a curve chosen for its own specimen (a fixed logistic, because a worm population grows).

[[bubbles_random]] is the other: 'a bubble dish has no growth curve, so this plate carries a flat-topped histogram between a marked floor and a marked ceiling'. Its note also states the rule this wing obeys everywhere — 'THE BUBBLES ARE NOT ROUTED THROUGH THE AXIS: every rung spawns the same cloud ... a variant that changed the specimen would be changing the answer rather than the showing'. Here the specimen is identical across the five CELLS for exactly that reason, and varies only with the axis, which is one level up.

[[abject_bench]] is `breach`. Its body 'drips down a glass plate, seeps past its drawn edge, reaches a pseudopod out into the world, then pulls back', and its truth line is softness 'that crosses its own edge'. [[membrane_bench]] is the same value from the other side — 'it lets the small through, turns the large away', the Markov blanket made flesh.

[[tentacle_grab_bench]] is `pull`, verbatim: 'grab the tip and the whole arm follows and TRAILS'. That single word is why this treatment's recruitment travels outward from the grab with a lag, and it is the only reason its series is an S curve instead of one more exponential approach.

[[octopus_bench]] is `drive` — 'the arm thinks where it touches', a boneless chain curling under its own actuation — with [[petri_dish_worms]], whose essence line is literally the travelling wave: offset = amplitude * sin(speed * t + i * phase).

[[softmill]] states the wing's thesis better than the wing does, and it is worth quoting whole because it was written by a member with no way to demonstrate it: 'an apparatus is the decision that something counts as a result. The mill supplies deformation forever; only the furniture around it decides whether that is a number, a difference, a history or an exhibit.' It is also `load`, with [[revolving_joy_ride]] — 'a carousel is a centrifuge for compliance, the soft bodies do not choose their shape, the rotation imposes it'.

[[jelly_cube]] contributed the scaling discipline: its kit is 're-dimensioned by a single factor u = cube_size / 0.5 so the family's proportions, accents and captions survive at this artifact's smaller scale'. This wing does the same thing for a different reason — five cells in one frame instead of one bench alone — and arrives at coarser marks rather than smaller ones, which is stated in dna.framing_note.

[[energy_landscape_bench]], [[becoming_bench]], [[rigidity_dial_bench]], [[grab_jelly_bench]], [[softbodytest]] and [[softbody_gallery_part1]], [[softbody_gallery_part2]], [[softbody_gallery_part3]] complete the census; which member is which value is set out in dna.kin.

[[csg_intersection_demo]] REFUSED this word, on the record, and was right: 'it is the softbody bench family's word for apparatus placed AROUND A SPECIMEN, and a Boolean demonstration has no specimen; transplanting it would force vitrine to mean something here or force it to be dropped, and dropping a rung from a nineteen-artifact word is exactly the drift the corpus keeps catching.' That refusal is the reason the word is still worth synthesising.

Structurally this is [[evidence_ladder]]'s rule and [[retention_corridor]]'s shape: one phenomenon evaluated ONCE at build time and drawn N ways side by side, so nothing on the object can disagree with anything else on it because there is nothing else for it to agree with. It replaces none of its sources — the walk-scale encounter with one bench standing in one regime is the curriculum, and this is the room that wants the comparison.

dna.default:
treatment=gravity. A SYNTHESIS HAS NO SHIPPED PLACEMENTS, so the default is a free design choice with no preservation duty to discharge, and this is the strongest single reading rather than the emptiest.

Three reasons, in order of weight. First, it is the family's dominant case: nine of the nineteen members put a body under a body force and let it find a shape nobody specified, against four for load, two for pull, two for drive and two for breach. Second, it is the treatment for which all four instruments have something to say — a slump has a crown for the arm to ride, a real departure for the pointer, an untreated twin, and a settling series with an overshoot in it — so a visitor who never touches the axis still meets every cell working. Third and sharpest: `gravity`'s envelope IS exp(-3.4 t) cos(13 t), the literal fourteen members type onto their record boards. At this one value the wing's chart draws what the family's charts draw, and at the other four it does not, so the default is the frame in which the family looks correct and every other frame is the correction.

NO PRESERVATION QUESTION ARISES, said plainly rather than left implied: this artifact did not exist before this pass and has zero placements. The rule that outranks everything in doc/DNA_PROMOTION_BRIEF.md is about promotions of placed artifacts; here it has no work to do.
dna.was: synthesized from the nineteen artifacts that declare `assay` (measured, not assumed: a sweep of every registry file returns exactly 19 declaring entries and exactly ONE value list among them). Nothing was promoted here — this artifact did not exist. It is the cross-member argument those nineteen promotions left in registry notes, built as a body.
dna.note:
THE FINDING, AND IT WAS MEASURED RATHER THAN NOTICED. Strip comments and blank lines from the four dressing builders in the nine bench members and hash them: `_assay_gauge`, `_assay_control`, `_assay_chart` and `_assay_vitrine` each come back as exactly TWO md5s, 7 files and 2 files, and the two differ from the seven by a variable name. Grep the record board's plotted expression across the whole family and `exp(-3.4 * f) * cos(f * 13.0)` appears in all nine benches and in jelly_cube; softmill plots exp(-3.0f)cos(11f) * 0.5; revolving_joy_ride and the softbody gallery plot exp(-3.2f)cos(14f). Fourteen artifacts, one damped oscillation, typed.

In NONE of the nineteen does an instrument read its specimen. The chart's ink is a literal — petri_dish_worms and bubbles_random substituted a different curve and both say in their own notes that theirs is fixed too. The control's reference cage is a hard-coded 0.10 m box whether the body beside it is a 0.16 m petri dish or a 0.6 m lattice. The gauge's arm hangs at ASSAY_TOP + 0.30 and its stylus stops at ASSAY_TOP + 0.10, which are heights on the bench and not readings off the body.

THAT IS NOT A BUG IN NINETEEN ARTIFACTS. It is what a still of ONE bench can afford. The apparatus exists to declare what KIND of claim is being made — this is a number, this is a difference, this is a history, this is an exhibit — and it declares that perfectly well without measuring anything. No member can discover the cost of that, because a member can only ever be one rung and has nothing to be compared against.

SO THE WING WIRES THEM, and reports what they then say:

  gravity  0.3648      breach   0.1991
  drive    0.3169      pull     0.2624      load  0.2669

Those are the five readings, in half-widths of mean displacement, on a column with 76 px of travel. `pull` and `load` land 0.4 PX APART — a corner drawn out into a spike and a body pressed flat under a platen, reported by the instrument as the same event. drive/load are 4.7 px apart, breach/pull 6.0, gravity/drive 4.5. Four of the ten pairs are inside 5 px of each other on the only cell that produces a number.

AND THE CHART CANNOT RESCUE IT, because a chart is the history of that same scalar. pull against load moves 0.084 % of the frame on the board; drive against load 0.055 %. The instrument that looks most like evidence adds a time axis to a quantity that had already thrown the answer away.

THE CONTROL SEPARATES ALL TEN, instantly and without a number, because 75 vectors are a SHAPE: load's point down and out in a uniform barrel, pull's converge on one corner and fan behind it, breach's exist only in a skirt with fifty-one masses of silence in the middle, drive's alternate up and down along the body, gravity's all point down and outward from a pinned floor.

SO THE ARC TURNS TWICE. Read as a list, none to vitrine is a progression from a thing loose in the world to a finished museum piece, and nineteen registry entries describe it that way. Put the five over one specimen and `gauge` adds an instrument and LOSES the shape; `chart` adds a history of the thing the gauge already lost; `control` — third of five, the least ceremonious apparatus on the row, a wire box and some sticks — is the only regime that keeps what happened; and `vitrine` is the only cell whose apparatus could be built without ever having seen the specimen, and is.

AND THE MEAN IS HONEST ABOUT BEING A MEAN, which is the second finding. `breach` moves 24 of its 75 masses by 0.3111 unit each — further than any single mass moves under load (0.2955) or drive (0.2079) — and leaves the other 51 exactly where they started. [CORRECTED 2026-08-12: gravity was named in that list and does not belong in it. An independent re-derivation of all five fields in Python puts gravity's corner-mass travel at 0.3886, ABOVE breach's 0.3111, because at t = 1 its envelope has settled to s = 0.9697 and a corner at h = 1.0 moves (0.1455, -0.3297, 0.1455). The claim holds against load and drive only; the finding it supports is unaffected.] Its mean departure is 0.1991, the LOWEST of the five. The gauge ranks a leak below a settle. Whether that is wrong depends entirely on what you wanted to know, and the third cell is the only place on the wing where you can find out. This is not a proxy that silently reports zero; it is a mean that reports what a mean reports, labelled as one, on a fixed scale, beside the thing it is a mean of.
dna.kin:
`assay` IS REFUSED AS THIS ARTIFACT'S AXIS, on the record, and the refusal is the design. All nineteen members use the word to stand in ONE regime and forgo the other four. On this wing all five stand at once and that simultaneity IS the object, so an axis whose every value demolishes four fifths of the exhibit is not a variation of it. That is evidence_ladder's ruling on `evidence` and retention_corridor's on `retention`. Adding a sixth value to hold a default would have been worse: it takes a family's word and quietly changes its value list, which is the failure tools/check_dna_declarations.py exists to catch one level down.

NEST OR SIDE BY SIDE — SIDE BY SIDE, and it was checked in the code rather than argued. Every member's dressing is a `match` with exactly one arm taken: _assay_vitrine builds glass and no gauge, _assay_chart a board and no cage, and nothing anywhere accumulates. `vitrine` in particular SUBTRACTS — it is not a chart with glass round it, it is glass instead of a chart. disclosure_cabinet's five NEST, each rung showing everything below it plus one more account, which is why showing all five there is just the top rung and why that artifact could take its family's word as its axis. These five are parallel readings, so showing all five is a new object and the word has to be exhibited instead of turned. Both rulings are right; they are rulings about different shapes.

WHAT IS TAKEN, CHARACTER FOR CHARACTER, AND HOW. The five value strings are never retyped in assay_wing.gd: `var _regimes := AssayFamily.ASSAYS`, preloaded from mass_spring_bench.gd — the slot_machine link, and the same mechanism disclosure_cabinet uses on prng_crank_machine. So are ASSAY_READ (0.98, 0.74, 0.26), ASSAY_WIRE (0.55, 0.88, 0.98) and ASSAY_TOP (0.86), which is this wing's cell floor. GDScript will not let a `match` arm or an @export_enum hint be computed, so the five strings do exist a second time as the const BUILT; _check_family() compares BUILT against the preloaded list element by element at _ready and push_errors on any divergence, and checks the bench height too. If a member ever renames a rung or adds a sixth, this artifact says so out loud instead of drawing four cells and a gap.

`treatment` IS THIS ARTIFACT'S OWN WORD and no sibling declares it (checked across every registry file: 422 distinct axis names, `treatment` appears zero times). It is also the word `assay` has been missing. In experimental design the assay is how you test and the treatment is what you did; the family's third rung is literally named `control`, which means nothing at all except relative to a treatment, and in nineteen artifacts nobody ever named what the control was a control FOR. This wing names it.

THREE NEARER WORDS WERE REFUSED, each for a reason. `phenomenon` belongs to [[evidence_ladder]] with fall | throw | bounce | drag — four ballistic events under one law, and not one of them could be spoken of a soft body, so taking the word would have meant a second vocabulary under one name, which is exactly the drift disclosure_cabinet's kin note documents. `specimen` belongs to [[constructive_proof]] with built | outline | candidates | absent, which is a question about how much of an object is present, not about what happened to it. `subject` belongs to [[sturtevant_bench]] and [[lineage_vitrine]], where its values are artifact tokens. Taking a word without its answers is the dishonest half of a shared vocabulary, and the corpus has ruled it twice (folding_past refusing `fold`, sierpinski_pyramid refusing `removal`).

THE VALUE LIST IS THE FAMILY'S OWN CENSUS, derived and not invented. All nineteen members were read and each puts its specimen under exactly one kind of forcing:

  gravity (9)  mass_spring_bench, energy_landscape_bench, becoming_bench,
               rigidity_dial_bench, softbodytest, softbody_gallery_part1,
               softbody_gallery_part2, softbody_gallery_part3, bubbles_random
  load    (4)  softmill, revolving_joy_ride, jelly_cube, jelly_variants
  breach  (2)  abject_bench, membrane_bench
  pull    (2)  grab_jelly_bench, tentacle_grab_bench
  drive   (2)  octopus_bench, petri_dish_worms

9 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 19. The list partitions the sources exactly; no forcing is left out and none is invented. ONE JUDGEMENT CALL, named so it can be disagreed with: [[bubbles_random]] is filed under `gravity` because buoyancy is a body force acting on a density difference and its bubbles are released and left alone, but its motion is upward and a reader could reasonably file it apart. Every other assignment is stated in the source artifact's own truth line.

DECLARED ORDER: the default first, then DESCENDING separation from it — gravity/breach 3.78 %, gravity/pull 3.51 %, gravity/drive 3.32 %, gravity/load 2.32 %. build_dna_gallery trims a value list from the TAIL, so a truncated sweep keeps the frames furthest apart and drops the weakest pair first rather than last. This is a different rule from the family's own, which orders by argument, and it is stated because the family's order has a consequence nobody has had to face yet: all nineteen declare `vitrine` last, so the first value a capped sweep would drop from any member is the only rung that stops studying the specimen — the one the wing exists to talk about.
dna.predicted_degeneracy:
PREDICTED BEFORE ANY CAPTURE, with arithmetic, and required to be falsifiable.

THE CLOSEST PAIR WILL BE gravity / load, AT ABOUT 2.32 % OF FRAME. Every other pair is predicted between 3.16 % and 3.78 %, so the prediction is not merely which pair but that it sits roughly 0.85 percentage points clear of the ninth-closest.

THE ARITHMETIC. Both treatments push the same lattice down and out from the same pinned floor, and their displacement fields agree in sign at every one of the 75 masses. Projected through the sweep camera at yaw 0.62 and pitch -0.26 with the wing at dna.framing 0.55, the paired beads separate by a MEAN OF 5.2 PX against a bead diameter of 6.4 px, and 49 % of the 75 beads still overlap their own twin. No other pair comes close: the next tightest is breach/load at 8.0 px mean and 37 % overlap, and the widest is gravity/pull at 13.8 px and 24 %. Multiply the un-overlapped disc area over five cells, add the departure field in the control cell (0.326 pp), the trace on the chart board (0.153 pp) and the pointer on the column (0.015 pp), and the total is 2.32 % against 3.78 % for gravity/breach.

THE PART OF THAT NUMBER THAT IS NOT THE SPECIMEN. Across the ten pairs the derived apparatus contributes 0.35 to 0.52 percentage points — 11 to 16 % of each pair's total. In every one of the nineteen members that contribution is exactly ZERO, because no member's apparatus reads its specimen. If a sweep comes back with the apparatus cells contributing nothing, the wiring has failed and the wing is nineteen artifacts again.

A SECOND DEGENERACY, PREDICTED AND DELIBERATELY LEFT IN. The gauge cell alone will be nearly blind. pull and load read 0.2624 and 0.2669, which is 0.4 px on a 76 px column and will measure as a twin; gravity/drive 4.5 px, drive/load 4.7, breach/pull 6.0, breach/load 6.4. Only 4 of the 10 pairs separate by more than 8 px there. The chart cell inherits it, because it plots the same scalar: pull/load 0.084 % and drive/load 0.055 % against gravity/breach's 0.155 %. THIS IS THE CONTENT AND IT WILL NOT BE FIXED. A reading spread that told the five apart would be a fact about coefficients chosen to spread it, and the wing's whole claim is that one number cannot carry five events. Compare foresight_range: an axis is allowed to be thin when the thing it describes is thin, and it must then say so with numbers.

AND ONE THING THAT SHOULD NOT MOVE AT ALL. The vitrine cell is byte-identical at every value except for the specimen standing inside it, and the shell, plinth, piers, lintel, cornice, sills, plates and header are byte-identical at every value full stop. If a pair's diff shows change in the masonry, something is reaching the geometry that should not be.
dna.still_note:
WHAT SHOULD BITE AND WHAT SHOULD NOT, said in advance so a number is read correctly rather than filed.

FOUR FIFTHS OF THE INK MOVES, and it moves for two different reasons that should be told apart in the report. The specimen is drawn in all five cells, so an axis that moves the specimen moves five copies of it — that is 1.83 to 3.25 percentage points of every pair. The instruments then follow it in three cells out of five, adding 0.35 to 0.52. The vitrine's case and the whole shell do not move at all.

THE `none` CELL IS NOT INERT AND IS NOT SUPPOSED TO BE, which is where this wing differs from evidence_ladder and retention_corridor. Their first stations are identical at every value by construction; this one carries the specimen bare and is the single largest contributor to every pair. That is the correct shape for a family whose axis is the APPARATUS: the thing loose in the world is exactly what the other four cells are regimes of.

THE FAMILY MEASURED, FOR COMPARISON, AND THE WING SHOULD NOT LAND IN ITS BAND. Twelve members have per-pair bite tables in doc/reports: abject_bench, becoming_bench, energy_landscape_bench, grab_jelly_bench, mass_spring_bench, membrane_bench, octopus_bench, revolving_joy_ride, rigidity_dial_bench, softbody_gallery_part2, tentacle_grab_bench and softmill. ELEVEN OF THE TWELVE PUT THEIR CLOSEST PAIR AT none/gauge, spread 0.170 % to 0.921 %, mean 0.477 %. TWELVE OF TWELVE put their widest pair at something/vitrine. softmill is the single exception on the closest pair (control/chart at 1.475 %) and its subject fills 80.75 % of frame, which is a different measurement regime entirely. That rank agreement across twelve independently promoted artifacts is what an honest shared vocabulary looks like, and it is the strongest such evidence in the corpus.

The wing is predicted at 2.32 %, roughly five times the family mean, and that is NOT a disagreement with them. Their axis moves a small piece of furniture standing beside an invariant specimen and their subject share is 3.1 % to 11.7 % of frame; this axis moves the specimen in all five cells and drags three instruments after it, at a subject share of 32.5 %. The wing would belong in the family's band only if it declared `assay`, which it refuses.

WHAT DOES CROSS OVER, and it is falsifiable here: the family's twelve tables say the GAUGE is the apparatus that changes the picture least. The wing says the gauge is the cell that changes least across `treatment` — 0.015 pp per pair, against the control cell's 0.19 to 0.36 pp. The lightest instrument in the family and the least informative one on the wing are the same instrument, found from two directions. If the wing's gauge cell comes back a large contributor, that convergence is wrong and this note should be struck.

WHAT WILL NOT READ IN A STILL, stated so it is not mistaken for a bug. The chart's ordinate ruling is 0.8 px thick and reads as a tone, not as four lines. The gauge's three plain graduations are 3.4 px and read as marks rather than as numbers. The vitrine's caption plate is a plate and carries no text at all, because a legible caption at 189 px/m would be 0.05 m of type and the family's own vitrine caption is a blank plate for the same reason. The 'SCALE 0 – 0.80' legend on the plinth is about 9 px of cap height: legible in VR, a smudge in the evidence, and it never changes with the axis so it cannot pad a measurement.

NO LABEL NAMES THE TREATMENT. Seven Label3D in the whole artifact — five cell names on the plinth, one header on the cornice, one scale legend — all non-billboard, so LabelFramer treats them as text already lying on a body and adds no plate. Every pixel that differs between gravity, breach, pull, drive and load is either a mass or an instrument reading one.

IF IT COMES BACK FAINT, check the framing before the design. The subject is 3.46 m wide and 0.54 m deep and the varying ink is five 0.56 x 0.60 cells inside it; this is the wide-flat case the brief's table warns about and dna.framing is set for it. If a sweep is run --staged, a 1.59 m floor-standing shell does not want a plinth under it and the pair AABB will grow; measure unstaged.
dna.framing_note:
ARITHMETIC, NOT TASTE, and derived from the UNION AABB across every value of the axis rather than from the default — which for this artifact is the same box, and that is checkable rather than lucky: the shell is identical at every value and every mass is contained inside it at every value with 0.033 m of clearance in x, 0.044 m in y and 0.025 m in z, measured value by value in Python. Nothing the axis can do changes the bounding box by a millimetre.

Mesh AABB 3.460 x 1.590 x 0.540, diagonal 3.8459, radius 1.9230. capture_config_sweep fits by DIAGONAL — dist = radius / tan(FOV/2) * PAD * framing, FOV 34, PAD 1.9 — so framing 1.0 already shows 1.9 bounding-sphere radii: the camera stands 11.95 m out, the visible frame is 7.31 m across, the wing projects to 43 % of it and ONE CELL is about 7 % — the dilution floor, exactly, for an axis that lives inside those cells.

At 0.55 the camera comes to 6.573 m and the frame to 4.019 m. At the sweep's yaw of 0.62 rad the row projects to 3.13 m, or 77.9 % of frame width, and at pitch -0.26 to 41.7 % of its height, so the subject is about 32.5 % of the frame — the same share evidence_ladder measured and reported as the healthiest in the synthesis wave, and well clear of the ~6 % floor. It also sets the scale everything else here was sized against: 189.1 px per metre, a 106 px cell, a 6.4 px bead at 15.1 px pitch, a 5.7 px chart trace and a 4.2 px departure vector.

0.50 was rejected on the margin, not on the subject share: it puts the row at 85.7 % of frame width, which is a gamble on the exact fit for a subject whose whole length is the point. 0.60 drops the subject to 27.3 % and the bead to 5.9 px for nothing gained.

AND THE PLINTH WAS PRICED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. 0.86 m of the wing's 1.59 m height is plinth, which is 54 % of the height carrying no content, and the obvious economy is to cut it. It is worth 6.6 % of scale and no more, because the diagonal is set almost entirely by the 3.46 m width — so the plinth costs 0.4 px on a bead and buys a standing viewer's eye level in VR. It stays, at the family's own ASSAY_TOP of 0.86, read from mass_spring_bench rather than typed.
dna.fixture_note:
NO FIXTURE AND NO SEED, and the absence is checkable rather than claimed: there is not one call to randf, randi or randomize in the file, and not one node lookup, timer or reference to the scene tree outside this artifact's own children. Every field is closed-form trigonometry and exponentials on a lattice generated by integer division, so two builds of one value are the same object down to the vertex. _ready is ungated and builds the whole wing standalone, so nothing has to be supplied for the still. There is no _process and no _physics_process — the treatment is evaluated once at build time and drawn — so a capture's settle time cannot photograph this artifact half way through anything, which is the failure mode the 0.35 s settle rule exists for.

ONE PRELOAD, and it is the only external dependency: mass_spring_bench.gd, for ASSAYS, ASSAY_READ, ASSAY_WIRE and ASSAY_TOP. It is compiled, never instantiated, and no soft body is ever built.
dna.budget_note:
About 490 MultiMesh instances at the heaviest value (5 x 75 specimen beads + 75 pale untreated beads + up to 75 departure segments + 24 trace segments) and about 60 MeshInstance3D of shell, cage, board, column and case, plus 7 Label3D. Well under the ~3200 element budget. ONE StaticBody3D with ONE BoxShape3D for the whole wing — a body you can walk into rather than one per cell, which is the 8000-static-bodies watchdog lesson taken at the design stage; a CollisionShape3D is not a MeshInstance3D so it does not touch the capture AABB.

THE MARKS ARE DOT CLOUDS AND ORIENTED BOXES, NOT LINE STRIPS. A PRIMITIVE_LINE_STRIP comes back a hairline in a 760 px still, which is the documented way an axis reads as inert when it is not, and the specimen is drawn as spheres at the masses because that is mass_spring_bench's own picture of a mass-spring lattice.

EVERY MESH IS INSIDE THE SHELL, MultiMesh included and checked value by value, so the capture AABB is the real body and no layers = 0 extent anchor is needed.
declines: `assay` AS THIS ARTIFACT'S AXIS — refused, see dna.kin. It would bite enormously, because four fifths of the frame would change between values, and that is most of what is wrong with it: the wing's entire claim is that the five regimes stand at once and that the arc turns twice, which is invisible to any object that can be only one regime at a time — which is every one of the nineteen. The large number it would produce would be a measurement of the exhibit being dismantled.

`assay` AS A SPOTLIGHT — one cell lit, four dimmed. Refused on evidence_ladder's second ground, which transfers without modification: dimming is MOUNTING. It changes how the exhibit is lit, not what it argues, and that is the one thing an axis is not allowed to do.

A TIME AXIS — the settling rate, the wave frequency, the creep exponent, the platen speed. All real, all still-invisible, all the info_board result verbatim. The wing's answer is not to declare them but to evaluate the whole run once and put its HISTORY on a board, which is the only part of a rate a still can hold.

SEEDING THE SPECIMEN, and this is a decline against the corpus's habit rather than with it. Nine members pin a spawn_seed as a fixture because their bodies are drawn from unseeded randf; this wing has no randomness at all, so there is nothing to pin, and a seed ladder would have been five samples of one rule — the picture the wing already has five of.

A SECOND AXIS ON THE INSTRUMENT'S HONESTY — the gauge wired to the specimen against the gauge hanging at a fixed height, the family's own version against the wing's. It is the sharpest question this artifact raises and it is declined because it would change ONE cell out of five, roughly a fifth of the ink and less than the critic's hottest-5 % window is wide once the wing is framed. A faint verdict there would be a fact about dilution rather than about the wiring. The honest way to show it is what the wing already does: the family's version stands in nineteen rooms and this one stands here, and the registry says which is which.

INSTANCING THE SOURCE SCENES — one mass_spring_bench, one petri_dish_worms, one softmill standing in the cells. Refused because the sources are live physics machines with SoftBody3D solvers, grab points, VR control racks, _process loops and per-frame respawns; five of them in one scene would be five rooms in a trench coat, and every one of them would be photographed mid-relaxation. What the wing needs from them is their CLAIM and their NUMBERS, so the vocabulary, the palette, the bench height and gravity's own envelope constants are read or taken from the source files exactly, and nothing else is.

STANDING THE CONTROL BESIDE THE SPECIMEN, as all nineteen members do. Declined on measurement: in a 106 px cell two half-size copies are two illegible clouds, and a beside-standing reference cannot carry the departure vectors, which are the entire content of a comparison. The WORD is unchanged — a second, untreated copy at the size the body had before anything happened to it — and only the registration moved. Recorded here rather than left as a silent difference, because a synthesis that quietly restages its family's rung is doing the thing this corpus keeps catching.
